ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-first diagnostic intake and health awareness assistant for rural community health workers.
ideas.problem_statement: The application of Artificial Intelligence in rural development and economic empowerment
ideas.title: AshaVoice
ideas.track: Application of Artificial Intelligence in rural development
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles rural healthcare accessibility using multi-language voice triage, matching the winning pattern of SAGACITY by addressing local health literacy barriers.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight cold-chain and inventory verification platform using local computer vision to flag spoiled agricultural produce at transit hubs.
ideas.title: AgriTrace Supply
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides concrete economic impact by reducing spoilage waste, directly fitting the open innovation theme for agricultural logistics with a working visual classifier.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first computer vision fall detection and emergency alert system utilizing existing webcams for elderly care homes.
ideas.title: ElderCare Radar
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages local pose estimation models via a built-in camera, echoing the Qualcomm Hack4Soc winning pattern for offline edge-based action recognition.

ideas.pitch: A satellite and raster-based data dashboard estimating localized carbon sink absorption rates and industrial emissions for rural micro-regions.
ideas.title: EcoScope Carbon
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the geospatial monitoring pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS to environmental tracking, giving judges a data-rich, visual dashboard with clear environmental value.

ideas.pitch: An automated micro-loan readiness and financial literacy copilot tailored for rural self-help groups using simplified local dialect generation.
ideas.problem_statement: The application of Artificial Intelligence in rural development and economic empowerment
ideas.title: GraminFin AI
ideas.track: Application of Artificial Intelligence in rural development
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses economic empowerment through transparent, accessible AI tools that can be demonstrated live with realistic mock financial profiles.
